acceptance_dimensions.name: originality
acceptance_dimensions.description: Novel artistic and conceptual contribution; a new provocation, framework, or perspective; not a restatement of existing work or precedent.

acceptance_dimensions.name: methodological_rigor
acceptance_dimensions.description: The practice-based methodology fits the artistic inquiry; the making and realization are documented; technical and process choices are sound; limitations are disclosed.

acceptance_dimensions.name: evidence_sufficiency
acceptance_dimensions.description: Every claim is anchored to an evidence type (work, process, exhibition, lineage, reflection); reception claims have an observable anchor; novelty and capability claims are anchored or hedged; no unsupported assertions.

acceptance_dimensions.name: argument_coherence
acceptance_dimensions.description: Logic flows across sections; transitions are smooth; thesis-to-conclusion alignment holds; no self-contradiction.

acceptance_dimensions.name: writing_quality
acceptance_dimensions.description: Language is clear and precise; grammar, formatting, and citation style are consistent; readability fits the venue.

per_dimension_criteria.what_to_look_for: The paper names a specific conceptual contribution or provocation; it engages precedent works and theory substantively (not list-citation); it identifies what its practice reveals that prior work did not.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_block: Contribution or provocation is vague or absent; precedent works are listed without engagement; the paper restates known positions with no added insight from the practice.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_warn: Contribution exists but is weakly differentiated from cited precedent; engagement with precedent and theory is uneven.

per_dimension_criteria.what_to_look_for: The practice-based methodology is named and justified against the artistic inquiry; the making and realization are documented (process, materials, exhibition); technical choices are described in enough detail to be credible; limitations are explicit.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_block: The methodology does not match the artistic inquiry; the realization is undocumented or implausible; limitations are not discussed; the making cannot be understood from the description.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_warn: The methodology is sound but the realization is insufficiently documented; some choices lack justification; limitations are mentioned but not engaged with.

per_dimension_criteria.what_to_look_for: Every claim is anchored to an evidence type (work, process, exhibition, lineage, reflection); reception claims name an observable anchor (venue/date + observable detail); precedent and theory citations are appropriate; reflection stays within what the work supports.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_block: Multiple core claims lack an evidence anchor; reception inflation (audience-effect claims with no observable anchor); novelty or capability claims unanchored and unhedged; reflection exceeds what the work supports.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_warn: Core claims are anchored but some secondary claims lack support; anchoring is uneven across sections.

per_dimension_criteria.what_to_look_for: The provocation raised in the Introduction is addressed in the Conclusion; section-to-section transitions are present; the thesis is consistent across Abstract, Introduction, and Conclusion.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_block: Multiple logical gaps between sections; conclusion disconnected from the provocation; self-contradictory passages.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_warn: Overall logic holds but some transitions feel forced; minor inconsistencies between section claims.

per_dimension_criteria.what_to_look_for: Register is consistently academic; grammar errors are rare; citation format is internally consistent; figures and tables are referenced in text.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_block: Difficult to understand; numerous grammar errors; colloquial register; citation format inconsistent across the manuscript.
per_dimension_criteria.what_triggers_warn: Readable but with several grammar or word-choice issues; some paragraphs overly long; minor citation format inconsistencies.

failure_conditions.expression: one or more mandatory dimensions score 'warn'
the evaluator's own scoring plan triggers 'warn' on a high or normal-priority dimension AND no mandatory dimension scores 'block' or 'warn'
round 2 still shows mandatory-dimension block after a writer revise_in_phase_4b attempt
every mandatory dimension scores 'pass' AND no dimension scores 'block'
